name: 奶油香脆带壳夏威夷果款
description: 深棕暖调奶油味带壳坚果套图，悬浮主图到开果演示与信任收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep cocoa brown #4A2A1D gradient for hero and trust screens, warm cream #F7F0DE for info screens, natural wood surfaces for scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm studio light with a front-left key, gentle falloff, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: natural light-wood slice #C9A876 and matte cream board #F7F0DE
styleLock.typography: friendly rounded sans-serif, minimal copy budget per screen
styleLock.iconSystem: solid-circle badge icons in a single caramel accent #B5722F
styleLock.presentationRules: stable straight-on or slight 3/4 product angle, centered placement, natural fresh food rendering with realistic shell and kernel texture
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium snack-food visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep cocoa brown #4A2A1D, warm cream #F7F0DE, wood tan #C9A876 and one caramel accent #B5722F; soft warm studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; friendly rounded sans-serif typography kept minimal; simple solid-circle badge icons only; appetizing natural food photography with the product always fresh and in sharp focus; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 深棕底悬浮木碗盛带壳夏威夷果、大字标语与英文副标；P2 米色底植物插画、果仁圆形微距与四枚营养圆标（英文标注混乱且雷同）；P3 木桩上的带壳果与果仁、两只包装袋、三枚图标卖点；P4 三段图文横排（挑选/保存/口感主题）配果仁特写；P5 果肉饱满特写并以圆形图引出开果话题；P6 开口器实物、袋内位置、拧开演示三卡与牛皮袋包装正反面；P7 深棕底供应链叙事、大圆图占位与四节点冷库时间线；P8 四条金色绶带空图位、木桩坚果与包装袋收口，左下角有二维码与会员角标。品类判定：品名夏威夷果（澳洲坚果）、奶油口味、带壳零食形态、随袋附开口器，硬证据指向食品饮料/休闲零食，与源夹名一致但按图判定。已剥离：品牌包装美术与字标、英文字标句、二维码与会员角标、产地表述（源页前后出现两种矛盾说法，均不采用）、营养素圆标与功效说法、冷链冷库等工艺承诺、包装上的条码与认证标；以上一律改为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 或空白占位。
